It preserves verification quality and actual historical output rather than rewriting it.

### Final-review correction checks

Exactly one primary action; rank 1 equals it; subsequent/dependent steps are labelled; status summaries use **Status overview**; explicit no-action option. All G3/G4/G5 technical templates, illustrative facts and diagnostic histories are closed or linked. All original full SHAs, CI facts, regression findings, safety/hardware limits and unresolved risks are preserved. Actual blind output remains verbatim, with its historical mismatch labelled. The current published feedback is paraphrased with provenance and exposure limits.
